name: Huick Alpha
summary: Plan a short episode the way the team writes its Docs (concept, cast and recordings, cutouts, materials, scene-by-scene dialogue, screen direction and article excerpts) and have Clipper make the Draft with your template.

compatibility.selects: Needs a Selects build whose run_script SDK has selects.clipper.startRun (Clipper production-plan hotfix, November 2026) and the Clipper template the plan targets imported. Uses only the Panel SDK: runScript. Windows and released-version compatibility are unverified.

de.name: Huick Alpha
de.summary: Plane eine kurze Folge wie im Team-Dokument (Konzept, Besetzung und Aufnahmen, Freisteller, Material, Dialog, Bildregie und Artikelzitate je Szene) und lass Clipper den Draft mit deiner Vorlage erstellen.

en.name: Huick Alpha
en.summary: Plan a short episode the way the team writes its Docs (concept, cast and recordings, cutouts, materials, scene-by-scene dialogue, screen direction and article excerpts) and have Clipper make the Draft with your template.

es.name: Huick Alpha
es.summary: Planifica un episodio corto como en el documento del equipo (concepto, reparto y grabaciones, recortes, materiales, diálogo, dirección en pantalla y citas por escena) y deja que Clipper cree el Draft con tu plantilla.

fr.name: Huick Alpha
fr.summary: Planifiez un court épisode comme dans le document de l'équipe (concept, distribution et enregistrements, détourages, médias, dialogues, mise en scène et extraits d'articles par scène) et laissez Clipper créer le Draft avec votre modèle.

ja.name: Huick Alpha
ja.summary: チームの企画書と同じ形（コンセプト、キャストと録画、切り抜き、素材、シーンごとの台詞・画面指示・記事引用）で短い回を企画し、ClipperがテンプレートでDraftを作ります。

ko.name: 휙알파
ko.summary: 팀이 Docs에 쓰는 방식(컨셉, 캐릭터와 녹화, 누끼, 자료, 씬별 대사·화면 지시·기사 원문)으로 짧은 회차를 기획하면 Clipper가 템플릿으로 Draft를 만듭니다.

pt.name: Huick Alpha
pt.summary: Planeje um episódio curto como no documento da equipe (conceito, elenco e gravações, recortes, materiais, diálogo, direção de tela e trechos de artigos por cena) e deixe o Clipper criar o Draft com seu modelo.

tr.name: Huick Alpha
tr.summary: Kısa bir bölümü ekibin dokümanındaki gibi planla (konsept, oyuncular ve kayıtlar, dekupe, malzemeler, sahne bazında diyalog, ekran yönlendirmesi ve makale alıntıları) ve Clipper Draft'ı şablonunla oluştursun.

zh.name: Huick Alpha
zh.summary: 按团队策划文档的方式（概念、角色与录像、抠像、素材、每场的台词、画面指示和文章摘录）策划一集短片，由 Clipper 用你的模板生成 Draft。
